G1_C1.title: Move Forward
G1_C1.goal: Move the turtle forward to the target.
G1_C1.learningObjective: Learn the 'forward(n)' command to move the turtle.

G1_C2.title: Turn Right
G1_C2.goal: Turn the turtle to face the target.
G1_C2.learningObjective: Learn the 'turn(d)' command to change the turtle's direction.

G1_C3.title: Draw a Line and Turn
G1_C3.goal: Move forward and then turn left.

G1_C4.title: Draw a Square
G1_C4.goal: Draw a full square by repeating commands.
G1_C4.learningObjective: Understand how to create shapes with a sequence of commands.

G1_C5.title: Pen Up and Down
G1_C5.learningObjective: Learn to use 'penUp()' and 'penDown()' to control drawing.

G1_C6.title: Changing Colors
G1_C6.goal: Draw a red line and then a blue line.
G1_C6.learningObjective: Learn to use 'setColor(c)' to change the pen color.

G2_C1.title: Loop a Square
G2_C1.goal: Draw a square using the 'repeat' command.
G2_C1.learningObjective: Learn how to use loops to repeat commands and write more efficient code.

G2_C2.title: Loop a Triangle
G2_C2.goal: Draw an equilateral triangle using the 'repeat' command.
G2_C2.learningObjective: Practice using loops with different angles.

G2_C3.title: Loop a Pentagon
G2_C3.goal: Draw a pentagon using a loop.
G2_C3.learningObjective: Calculate the correct angle for a 5-sided shape (360/5).

G2_C4.title: Dashed Line with a Loop
G2_C4.goal: Draw a dashed line using a loop.
G2_C4.learningObjective: Combine pen controls and movement inside a loop.

G3_C1.title: Function for a Square
G3_C1.goal: Define and use a function to draw a square.
G3_C1.learningObjective: Learn to create functions to reuse code.

G3_C2.title: Function with a Size Parameter
G3_C2.goal: Create a function that can draw squares of any size.
G3_C2.learningObjective: Learn to use parameters to make functions more powerful.

G3_C3.title: Function to Draw a House
G3_C3.goal: Combine a square and a triangle function to draw a house.
G3_C3.learningObjective: Learn to compose functions to create more complex drawings.

G4_C1.title: Variable for Length
G4_C1.goal: Use a variable to control the length of a line.
G4_C1.learningObjective: Learn to declare and use variables to store values.

G4_C2.title: Growing Spiral
G4_C2.goal: Use a variable that changes in a loop to draw a spiral.
G4_C2.learningObjective: Learn how to modify variables within a loop.

G4_C3.title: Math with Variables
G4_C3.goal: Draw a half-square using a variable and division.
G4_C3.learningObjective: Learn to perform simple arithmetic operations on variables.

G5_C1.title: Conditional Color
G5_C1.goal: Draw a line that changes color halfway.
G5_C1.learningObjective: Learn to use 'if' statements to control program flow.

G5_C2.title: Wall Bounce
G5_C2.goal: Make the turtle turn around when it hits a 'wall'.

G5_C3.title: If/Else Branching
G5_C3.goal: Draw a shape with alternating colors using an if/else statement.
G5_C3.learningObjective: Learn to use if/else statements for branching logic.
